Carpooling.badDiscrepancyEvent: Collects samples admitting a compatible run with excessive discrepancy.
Carpooling.bad_discrepancy_subset: Shows that excessive discrepancy implies the presence of a large component.
Carpooling.stochastic_upper_tail: Bounds the probability of large discrepancy through witness counting.
Carpooling.stochasticThreshold: Chooses the logarithmic component threshold for the basic stochastic bound.
Carpooling.stochastic_basic_high_probabi: Proves the basic cube-root logarithmic bound with failure probability at most 1/n.
Carpooling.productLowerFailure: Defines failure of the lower bound in the product clique-sampling model.
Carpooling.iid_cliques_lower_probability: Averages over arrival schedules to prove the lower bound for independent clique requests.
Carpooling.multiset_choose_card: Extracts a submultiset of any allowed size.
Carpooling.refined_cover_of_forest: Extracts a tree witness with encoded surplus edges from a request forest.
Carpooling.badRefinedEvent: Detects a component or surplus pattern that can violate the refined bound.
Carpooling.refined_bad_event_cover: Covers refined bad events by large-tree and surplus-witness events.
Carpooling.large_witness_tail: Bounds the probability of a witness exceeding the chosen size threshold.
Carpooling.uniformProb_union_le: Bounds the probability of two events' union by the sum of their probabilities.
Carpooling.refined_witness_regular_bound: Specializes refined witness counting to the regular-graph sampling parameters.
Carpooling.stochastic_refined_tail: Combines tree-size and surplus-edge tails into the refined discrepancy estimate.
Carpooling.batchCutoff: Counts how many requests of a given batch occur before a global time.
Carpooling.batchCutoff_le: Shows that a batch cutoff never exceeds the batch length.
Carpooling.batchCutoff_before: Shows that a batch contributes no requests before it starts.
Carpooling.batchCutoff_after: Shows that a completed batch contributes its full length.
Carpooling.batchedGreedyState: Adds local Greedy states to obtain discrepancy across restarted batches.
Carpooling.states_prefix_congr: Shows that Greedy states depend only on requests already received.
Carpooling.Request.move_adj: Shows that processing a graph-edge request uses adjacent vertices.
Carpooling.uniformProb_compl: Computes the probability of an event's complement.
Carpooling.theorem_1_2_basic: Gives one high-probability event controlling all prefixes of the basic batched bound.
Carpooling.theorem_1_2_refined: Gives one high-probability event controlling all prefixes of the refined batched bound.
Carpooling.theorem_1_2_basic_greedy: Bounds every prefix of batched Greedy by the basic cube-root logarithmic rate.
Carpooling.theorem_1_2_refined_greedy: Bounds every prefix of batched Greedy using the graph degree for a sharper rate.
Carpooling.exists_top_set: Finds a vertex set of a given size with maximum total position.
Carpooling.topSet: Chooses the vertices with the largest positions.
Carpooling.topSum: Sums the largest specified number of vertex positions.
Carpooling.topSet_spec: Verifies the size and maximizing property of the chosen top set.
Carpooling.sum_le_topSum: Bounds any set's position sum by the top sum of the same size.
Carpooling.topSum_zero: Shows that the sum of zero largest positions is zero.
Carpooling.topSum_nonpos: Shows that nonpositive positions have nonpositive top sums.
Carpooling.topSum_all: Identifies the full top sum with the total over all vertices.
Carpooling.le_topSum_one: Bounds every individual position by the largest position.
Carpooling.topSum_step: Controls how a Greedy update changes sums of the largest positions.
Carpooling.Run.clusters: Tracks components formed by the requests seen so far.
Carpooling.Run.IsInternal: Detects a request whose endpoints are already connected.
Carpooling.Run.surplus: Counts requests beyond those needed to connect components.
Carpooling.log_add_strict: Relates component-size logarithms when merging two positive-sized sets.
Carpooling.Run.clusters_mono: Shows that a vertex's component can only grow over time.
Carpooling.Run.rank: Assigns a logarithmic size rank to a vertex's component.
Carpooling.Run.rank_mono: Shows that component rank cannot decrease during a run.
Carpooling.Run.shift: Subtracts twice the component rank from each vertex position.
Carpooling.Run.shift_step: Shows that a rank-shifted Greedy step satisfies the dissipative update rules.
Carpooling.Run.shifted: Packages rank-shifted positions as a dissipative run.
Carpooling.Run.shifted_count: Identifies the shifted run's charges with surplus requests.
Carpooling.Run.clusters_neg: Shows that reversing discrepancy signs preserves request components.
Carpooling.Run.surplus_neg: Shows that reversing signs preserves the surplus count.
Carpooling.tree_like_surplus_bound: Bounds discrepancy by the cube root of surplus requests plus a logarithmic term.
Carpooling.Run.surplus_succ: Updates the surplus count when the next request arrives.
Carpooling.Clusters.singletons_parts_car: Counts the components in the initial singleton partition.
Carpooling.Run.surplus_identity: Relates surplus requests to total requests and the remaining component count.
Carpooling.lemma_4_2: Bounds discrepancy for connected request sequences using their surplus edges.
Carpooling.fiber_card_subtype: Equates two ways of counting the preimages of a value.
Carpooling.constant_fiber_card: Counts a domain when every output has the same number of preimages.
Carpooling.constant_fiber_preimage_card: Counts the preimage of an event under a constant-fiber map.
Carpooling.uniformProb_constant_fiber: Shows that equal-sized decoding fibers preserve uniform probabilities.
Carpooling.word_fiber_card: Counts the preimages of an entire sequence under a constant-fiber decoder.
Carpooling.le_four_cuberoot: Converts a cubic inequality into an explicit cube-root bound.
Carpooling.lemma_3_1: Bounds positive discrepancy by the cube root of the expanding-move count.
Carpooling.theorem_1_1: Bounds every vertex’s discrepancy by 4 times the cube root of the request count, or n, whichever is smaller.
Carpooling.scheduled_varying_targets_low: Proves a forcing bound for target cliques with varying scheduled sampling frames.
Carpooling.scheduled_varying_targets_of_: Derives the varying-schedule bound from sufficient requests in each target clique.
Carpooling.splitFailure: Collects schedule and local-sample pairs where the lower-bound forcing fails.
Carpooling.weighted_cliques_lower_probab: Averages conditional clique bounds over the weighted arrival schedules.
Carpooling.classCount: Counts the requests assigned to a particular sampling class.
Carpooling.classCount_variance: Computes the variance of a class count under uniform sampling.
Carpooling.Witness.shape: Removes vertex labels to retain only a witness tree's shape.
Carpooling.Witness.shape_nodes: Shows that removing labels preserves the witness node count.
Carpooling.Witness.decorate: Enumerates graph-respecting labelings of a tree shape.
Carpooling.Witness.decorate_card_le: Bounds the number of labelings using the graph's maximum degree.
Carpooling.Witness.mem_decorate: Shows that a valid witness is among its shape's enumerated labelings.
Carpooling.Witness.families: Enumerates rooted graph-respecting witnesses with a fixed number of nodes.
Carpooling.Witness.mem_families: Shows that every valid witness of the right size appears in the enumeration.
Carpooling.Witness.families_card_le_cata: Bounds witness counts using Catalan tree shapes and degree choices.
Carpooling.Witness.catalan_le_four_pow: Bounds the number of binary tree shapes by a power of four.
Carpooling.Witness.families_card_bound: Bounds the number of size-r witnesses by n times (4Δ)ʳ.
Carpooling.Run.edgeBag: Records all request edges seen so far, including repeated edges.
Carpooling.Run.edgeBag_mono: Shows that the request multiset grows with time.
Carpooling.Run.edgeBag_prefix: Shows that taking a run prefix preserves its earlier request multisets.
Carpooling.inBlock: Tests whether an edge belongs to a selected component block.
Carpooling.inBlock_pair: Relates block membership of an unordered edge to endpoint membership.
Carpooling.selected: Selects requests belonging to a chosen vertex set.
Carpooling.selected_union: Splits selected requests across two disjoint vertex sets.
Carpooling.Run.component_witness: Builds a graph-respecting witness for a component's requests, retaining repeats.
Carpooling.Run.clusters_subset: Shows that earlier components lie inside later components.
Carpooling.Run.terminal_closed: Shows that a final request component is closed under all earlier requests.
Carpooling.Run.selected_card: Identifies the number of selected edges with the internal-request count.
Carpooling.component_bound_all_prefixes: Uses a component's total request budget to bound all of its prefix discrepancies.
Carpooling.Witness.edges: Lists a rooted witness tree's edges with their multiplicities.
Carpooling.Witness.vertices: Collects all vertices appearing in a rooted witness.
Carpooling.Witness.Valid: Requires every edge of a witness to respect graph adjacency.
Carpooling.Witness.root_mem: Shows that the witness vertex set contains its root.
Carpooling.Witness.edges_card: Shows that a witness has one edge per tree node.
Carpooling.Witness.append: Joins two witness trees at their common root.
Carpooling.Witness.edges_append: Shows that appending witnesses adds their edge multisets.
Carpooling.Witness.vertices_append: Shows that appending witnesses unions their vertex sets.
Carpooling.Witness.valid_append: Shows that appending valid witnesses preserves graph adjacency.
Carpooling.Witness.graft: Attaches a witness at a vertex already present in another witness.
Carpooling.Witness.reroot: Moves a witness's root to any vertex it contains.
Carpooling.Witness.extend_spanning: Extends a witness toward a spanning tree of the desired vertex set.
Carpooling.Witness.spanning: Extracts a spanning-tree witness while keeping only edges of the original witness.
